fusions.name: Driven to the Head
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A hammering blow drives a spike into the target, dealing 24 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Flattening Drive
fusions.desc: Slams a ring of spikes into the ground around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. It ignores armour, strips 15% of their armour for 6 seconds and slows each by 20%.

fusions.name: Tempered Edge
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to hammer your spines to an edge, then increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Blow upon Blow
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
